description: App-by-action coverage for Zekvar Browser. Edit this file, then run node scripts/coverage-doc.mjs to regenerate docs/coverage.md.

statuses.supported: On by default for the app and proven by a named controlled-fixture connected test for this app, action, and mode.
statuses.experimental: Implemented, but the app is opt-in or the named tests prove this mode through a sibling app, a shared engine unit test, or a different mode.
statuses.unsupported: Not implemented. Browser does not intercept or offer this mode.

evidence.fixture: Controlled fixture: Playwright drives real Chrome with the extension against a local page shaped like the app, served at the app origin.
evidence.unit: Unit test of the shared inspection engine without a browser.
evidence.live-signed-out: Optional live check against the public signed-out site (node scripts/verify-demo.mjs --live). Results are not recorded in the repository.
evidence.live-signed-in: Live check against a signed-in customer workspace. None exists yet.
